question: What is the average area of the windmills in the image given the GSD of 0.562?
final_answer_preview:
The average area of the windmills in the image, considering the Ground Sample Distance (GSD) of 0.562 meters per pixel, is **81.37 square meters**.

This value was calculated by analyzing the detected windmills and applying the GSD to convert pixel measurements into real-world dimensions. The result represents the mean area across all identified windmills in the image.
